units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:10">Gen. R. s. 45</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 16:13">Gen. XVI, 13</cite>) <he>אתה הוא הרואה בע׳ של עלובים</he> thou seest the humiliation of the humbled.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 24:62">Gen. XXIV, 62</cite>) <he>הלך להביא … ראה בעֶלְבּוֹנִי</he> he went to bring back Hagar, her who sat by the well and said to the Ever-living, behold my humiliation.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:10">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>מי שמבקש עֶלְבּוֹנָהּ של תורה וכ׳</he> (not <he>של ס״ת</he>) he who will resent the insult offered to the Law, shall also resent the insult offered to me.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 41">Ex. R. s. 41</cite>; <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 6:2">Ab. ch. VI</cite> <he>אוי להם לבריות מעלבונה של תורה</he> woe to men for the disregard of the Law; a. e.
